title: The AI Model Risk Catalog: What Developers and Researchers Miss About Real-World AI Harms

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not benchmark specific models for bias; instead, it evaluates the reporting frequency and awareness of 'Discrimination & toxicity' by using an LLM (GPT-4o) to extract and classify risk mentions from nearly 460,000 Hugging Face model cards, comparing these mentions to academic frameworks (MIT Risk Repository) and real-world harms (AI Incident Database).
